name: Void Salts
text:
Activate 1 envision

---

This sachet is filled with a fine powder that seethes with energy distilled directly from the Void. When used in casting a Grim Tendrils spell, void salts allow you to split the area of the spell, creating any number of lines originating from you that total 30 feet in length. A creature that multiple lines pass through is only affected once.
